svg.title: A DNA economy, drawn as a double helix
svg.desc: Two strands twist upwards. One strand is the atoms: the same thickness all the way up. The other is know-how: it gets stronger with every turn. The rungs joining them are sunlight, one per day. The whole thing rises: what rises is what becomes possible.
svg.text: same strand all the way up
each rung is a day of sunlight
leave it better than you found it
